# Notifications and webhooks

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/api_reference.py from contracts/openapi; do not edit. -->

Base path: `https://<gateway>/notification`. Every call needs an API key or a Studio session (see [Authentication](index.md#authentication)). Request and response fields are in the OpenAPI document, `contracts/openapi/notification.json`.

| Method | Path | What it does | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/v1/emails` | Send one email for a platform service and log the delivery (without the address). | `EmailIn` | 202 `DeliveryOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/inbox` | What needs your attention, for your roles in this organization. |  | 200 `Inbox` |
| `POST` | `/v1/inbox/read` | Mark Read | `ReadIn` | 200 `Inbox` |
| `GET` | `/v1/webhooks` | List Webhooks |  | 200 list of `WebhookOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/webhooks` | Send matching events to your endpoint, signed with a secret shown only now. | `WebhookIn` | 201 `WebhookCreated` |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/webhooks/{webhook_id}` | Update Webhook | `WebhookPatch` | 200 `WebhookOut` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/webhooks/{webhook_id}` | Delete Webhook |  | 204 |
| `GET` | `/v1/webhooks/{webhook_id}/deliveries` | Deliveries |  | 200 list of `DeliveryRow` |
| `POST` | `/v1/webhooks/{webhook_id}/test` | Send a `notification.webhook.test` event now and report what the endpoint answered. |  | 200 `DeliveryRow` |
